title: Watt
features:
Main Tab

· Enable Aimbot (toggle)
· Custom Key picker (default Q)
· Smoothing (0–10)
· Show FOV Circle (toggle)
· Aim Part

TriggerBot

· Enable TriggerBot (toggle)
· Jump Check (toggle)
· Scope Check (toggle)
· Shot Cooldown (0–5 sec)
· Reaction Delay (0–5 sec)

---

Rage Tab

· Spinbot (toggle) 
· Big Head (toggle) 
· Custom Shoot Sound (toggle)

---

Visuals Tab

· ESP (toggle)
  · Box ESP (toggle) + Style (Corner / Full / 3D)
  · Tracer ESP (toggle)
  · Name ESP (toggle) + Show Distance (toggle)


· World Visuals
  · Night Mode 
  · Brightness slider 
  · World Color picker
  · Atmosphere 
  · Fog 
  · Bloom 
  · Weather 
  · Reset All Visuals button

---

Configs Tab

· Save / Load / Delete configs
· Auto‑load on startup

---

UI Settings Tab

· Open Keybind Menu (toggle)
· Custom Cursor (toggle)
· Menu Keybind picker (default Insert)
· Show FPS Counter (toggle)
· Unload button (cleanly removes everything)
· Theme groupbox – change UI colors / transparency
